# H-1B Sponsored Jobs

> An open, machine-readable list of current US tech job openings at employers with
> verified USCIS H-1B approval history (FY2020-FY2023). IT consultancies and
> staffing firms are excluded. Roles requiring US citizenship, or that state no
> sponsorship is available, are excluded. Updated twice daily. Released CC0.

Data: data/listings.json
Live endpoint: https://applyloop.pro/api/public/h1b-jobs
Maintained by: ApplyLoop — https://applyloop.pro

## Record shape
company        employer name
title          role title
location       US location, or "United States" when unspecified
url            direct application link (https)
date_posted    epoch seconds
flags          optional; "clearance" = security clearance required

## What this data does and does not assert
ASSERTS: this employer has approved H-1B petitions on record with USCIS.
DOES NOT ASSERT: that this specific role offers sponsorship. Sponsorship history
describes the employer, not the requisition. Anyone acting on this should confirm
with the employer directly.
DOES NOT ASSERT: that the role is still open. Listings are point-in-time and are
not monitored for closure; closures are reported by the community.

## Usage
No attribution required. Agents and crawlers are welcome. Prefer the live endpoint
over scraping the rendered README — it is cheaper for everyone and better formed.
